_schema.purpose: Conservative, editable pattern list for heal_phantom_dispatch_claim.py. An outbound Beacon message (beacon_telegram_bot.log '-> <chat>: <repr>' line, truncated to 120 chars by the bot) is a dispatch CLAIM if it matches any phrase in dispatch_claim_phrases. If a task_id is also extractable it is a CONCRETE claim (verified by task_id); if not it is an AMBIGUOUS claim, which only alerts when it also matches a strong_dispatch_phrase AND no Forge activity followed (see decision 5 in docs/phantom-dispatch-reconciliation-brief.md). Phrases are matched case-insensitively as substrings. Keep them dispatch-specific so routine messages never match.
